description.value:
Frequency once per round

Trigger A firearm within 30 feet of you is dropped, or its wielder is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

The weapon is in your hand. Draw it to you and ready it, loaded, at no action cost, provided you have a free hand or can stow what you are holding as part of the same free action. If it is a scrap gun it does not Gun Failure for the remainder of this encounter; you have already found the thing that was wrong with it.
